ng-gate-timeout-nonretryable.mechanism: When a contender loses the acquisition-gate turnstile under load, acquireAcquisitionGate returns an untyped {ok:false} at its deadline and acquireScanLease maps every gate failure to retryable:false, so ordinary contention is reported as a non-retryable fault and callers give up instead of retrying.

ng-dashboard-registry-torn-write.mechanism: The dashboard route writes the shared projects registry in place with fs.writeFile; a concurrent CLI loadRegistry reads a partial file, JSON.parse throws, the catch returns an empty registry, and the next save clobbers every other registration.

ibr-extractor-stale-cache.mechanism: isFileFresh compares the cached extractor binary only against main.swift and Package.swift, so edits to other Swift sources (such as Keyboard.swift) never trigger a rebuild and the stale binary keeps running.

spectra-envelope-missing-operation.mechanism: shadowCall and syntheticRequest build request envelopes without the operation field that the TypeScript server requires, so the backend rejects them as bad_request; the try? health probe silently falls back and every shadow call errors.

bl-handoff-queue-cap.mechanism: _queue_titles stops at a display limit of 5 and lists only top-level *.md files, while compose reports len(titles) as the queue count, so larger queues are under-counted and the backlog items/ subfolder is missed.

bl-experiment-upsert-first-only.mechanism: The experiment-row upsert replaces only the first (event, run_id) match and keeps any other existing duplicates, so the learn runner, which counts and averages rows, can treat one run as several samples.

arp-writeln-two-syscalls.mechanism: writeln! on an O_APPEND file issues the record and the newline as separate write calls, so concurrent appenders interleave between them and tear segment lines.

arp-ack-timeout-error.mechanism: After the message has already been delivered and recorded, an ack-wait timeout returns Err, which the inject caller propagates as a failure; callers retry and the message is delivered twice.

bl-procgov-unlocked-rmw.mechanism: The candidate dedup read and read-modify-write run without a lock, so concurrent writers overwrite each other's rows, and a prior file lacking a trailing newline gets its last row spliced onto the first new row.

ng-atomic-tmp-collision.mechanism: The temp path target.tmp.<pid>.<Date.now()> is unique per millisecond, not per call, so two same-target writes in one process within a millisecond share a temp file and one truncates the other before rename, publishing torn JSON.
